title: Hotshot Maneuver
text: Choose a friendly unit. For each of its “On Attack” abilities, deal 2 damage to a different enemy unit. Then, attack with the chosen unit.
rules:
Each instance of 2 damage must be dealt to a different unit. All damage is dealt simultaneously.
If you play Hotshot Maneuvers, you must attack with a unit, if able. Units must be ready in order to attack.
